tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies the 1Password Service Account token and connectivity by listing vaults.

tools.name: list-vaults
tools.description: List the 1Password vaults accessible to the connected Service Account. Returns vault id, title, description, type and active item count. Use this first to find the vault id for list-items.

tools.name: list-items
tools.description: List the items in a 1Password vault. Returns item id, title, category, tags and state (no field values). Use list-vaults to get the vault id, then this tool to find the item id for get-item-fields.

vaultId.description: The ID of the vault to list items from (get it from list-vaults).

includeArchived.description: Include archived items in the listing (default: false).

tools.name: get-item-fields
tools.description: Get the fields of a 1Password item, including the values of secret fields (passwords, API keys, credentials). Use list-items to find the item id. SECURITY: treat returned secret values as sensitive — use them for the requested action (e.g. writing a secrets file) and do not echo, log or persist them anywhere else.

vaultId.description: The ID of the vault containing the item.

itemId.description: The ID of the item to read (get it from list-items).
